sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:

ORDER Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.189/2022 registered at P.S. Sendhwa City, District Barwani (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 409, 120-B and 201/34 of IPC.
He is in jail since 21.09.2022.

His earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 21.11.2022 passed in MCRC No.54206/2022.
2.

As per the prosecution story, present applicant with the help of co- accused Anil Bhatore created a forged Patta of plot admearsuing 18 x 30 ft. of Najul Bhumi situated at Sharstri Colony, Sendhwa for taking illegal benefit.

Upon complaint of one Gajanand Soni,
inquiry was conducted and, thereafter, an FIR has been registered against the present applicant and other co-accused person.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
Applicant is in jail since 21.09.2022.
Co-accused Anil has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 29.05.2023 by vacation Judge passed in MCRC No.15418/2023 in the similar circumstances.
He is not aware of the fact that Patta was forged.
When as he came to know the genuineness of the Patta he immediately cancelled the sale agreement and repaid the amount as received in Prime Minister Scheme.
Applicant is an old person of 60 years of age.
He is under going treatment of brain hemorrhage, blood pressure and diabetes.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
He is a permanent resident of District Barwani.
Final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
4. Per-contra, learned counsel for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
However, he fairly admits that no criminal antecedent has been found against the present applicant.

5. Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.
6.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that co-accused Anil has been enlarged on bail by the order of co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the similar circumstances;
applicant is suffering jail incarceration for last 9 months; he has cancelled the sale agreement and repaid the entire amount received in Prime Minister Scheme and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
7. In view of the above, without commenting on the merits of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3)
Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE Anushree Kailash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82257049/
